About.title: About Me
About.name: Shin
About.intro: Hi, I'm Shin — a Master's student in Computer Science. My research focuses on software engineering, software testing, the research and application of machine learning, and the research and application of large language models.
About.freeTime: Outside of research, I love building things — from full-stack web apps to AI-powered tools. I'm always curious about new technologies and enjoy sharing what I learn through this blog.
About.masterDesc: Research in software engineering, software testing, machine learning, and large language models.
About.bachelorDesc: Studied Computer Science fundamentals, algorithms, data structures, and full-stack development. Active in China national programming and mathematical modeling competitions. Developed a racing game demo with Unreal Engine 4 as graduation project.
About.achievement1: MathorCup China National Mathematical Modeling Contest — 1st Prize (2019)
About.achievement2: Blue Bridge Cup China National Programming Contest — 2nd Prize (2018)
About.achievement3: CUMCM (China National Mathematical Modeling Contest) — 2nd Prize (2018)

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.subtitle: Things I've built and worked on.
Projects.koclawDesc: A secure, self-hosted AI Agent framework. Rust gateway + Python agent — one AI persona across Telegram, QQ, Discord, desktop, and web. Features E2E encryption, 27 MCP tools, voice pipeline, and cron scheduler.
Projects.ragDesc: A RAG-based Q&A system built as a learning project to explore retrieval-augmented generation. Uses LangChain, ChromaDB, and OpenAI to answer questions from Rust documentation. Supports English, Japanese, and Chinese.
Projects.shinBlogDesc: This personal blog — built with Next.js 15, React 19, and Tailwind CSS. Trilingual (EN/JA/ZH), with dark mode, Kokoron AI assistant, guestbook, knowledge base, command palette, and admin panel.

Snippets.title: Knowledge Base
Snippets.subtitle: Organized notes, references, and insights across topics I'm exploring.
Snippets.catLlmRagDesc: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases, and grounded AI systems
Snippets.catLlmSkillsDesc: Prompt engineering, tool use, and agent patterns
Snippets.catDevNotesDesc: Framework patterns, language tips, and engineering notes
Snippets.ragFundamentalsDesc: Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines document retrieval with LLM generation for grounded answers.
Snippets.vectorEmbeddingsDesc: How text embeddings work, choosing embedding models, and similarity metrics (cosine, dot product, L2).
Snippets.chunkingStrategiesDesc: Fixed-size, sentence-level, semantic, and recursive chunking. Trade-offs between context preservation and retrieval precision.
Snippets.loraQloraDesc: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with Low-Rank Adaptation. QLoRA adds 4-bit quantization for memory efficiency.
Snippets.trainingDataPrepDesc: Data cleaning, instruction formatting (Alpaca, ShareGPT), and quality filtering techniques.
Snippets.promptEngineeringDesc: Chain-of-thought, few-shot, system prompts, and structured output techniques.
Snippets.functionCallingDesc: Integrating LLMs with external tools via function calling (OpenAI, Anthropic) and agent frameworks.
Snippets.nextjsPatternsDesc: Server components, streaming, parallel routes, and i18n with next-intl.
Snippets.rustOwnershipDesc: Mental model for ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, and common patterns.
